contract.words: Collect $2,500 of settled cash within 21 days with no more than 3 hours a week of owner time.

terms.proofCondition: $2,500 of buyer payments settled within 21 days

strategy.title: Sell seating-chart and vendor run-sheet workbooks to wedding venue coordinators by email
strategy.why: Every link is on the card: payer (venue coordinators), published business emails, a dated buying signal (2026-11-24), $350 price, Brain-produced spreadsheet at $5 direct cost, $0 exposure, 3 days to first cash, 500 directory-listed venues and a measured 12% pre-order conversion (30/250). Eight sales = $2,800 gross ($2,760 net) inside 21 days. Brain performs reach, offer, delivery and collection, so owner time is 0 of the 3 hours a week allowed.

alternatives.title: No alternative opening
alternatives.why: Brain's run holds only this opening.

steps.label: Email coordinators of about 70-100 directory-listed wedding venues at their published business addresses
Offer the seating chart and vendor run-sheet workbook at $350
Close 8 sales at $350 (12% measured conversion)
Produce and deliver the workbook to each of 8 venues
Collect $350 from each of 8 venues

cash.label: 8 x $350 workbook payments
8 x $5 direct cost, paid from receipts

sources.claim: 500 wedding venues in the regional venue directory, weddings every weekend in season

strategy.title: Sell seating-chart and vendor run-sheet workbooks to wedding venue coordinators by email, delivered in weekly batches
strategy.why: Every link is on the card: payer, published business emails, a dated buying signal (2026-11-24), $350 price, Brain-produced spreadsheet at $5, $0 exposure, 3 days to first cash, 500 venues, 12% measured conversion (30/250). Eight sales = $2,800 gross ($2,760 net) settled by day 18 of 21. The card names no fulfillmentOwner and its deliverable is PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET, so Brain fulfils and the 1 humanHour per deal is Brain's; owner time is planned at 0. Deliveries are nevertheless batched 3/3/2 per week so that even if that hour fell to the owner each week stays within the 3 h/week ceiling (9 h window total).

alternatives.title: Deliver all 8 in week 1
alternatives.why: Rejected: harmless if Brain fulfils, but would need 8 h in one week if the per-deal hour were owner work.

Collect $350 from each of the 3 week-2 venues

Collect $350 from each of the 2 week-3 venues

Week 1: 3 x $5 direct cost, paid from receipts

Week 2: 3 x $5 direct cost, paid from receipts

quantities.name: ownerHours
quantities.needs: <= 3 h/week; worst case if the per-deal hour were owner work: 3, 3, 2 h in weeks 1-3

1 hour of work per deal by the fulfiller

answers.finding: ownerHours quantity is marked EVIDENCED = 0 citing s_delivery, but the card records humanHours: 1 and Brain's run lists the Deliver step as owner PERSON
answers.resolution: Partly accepted. Under the fulfilment rule humanHours is work per deal by the fulfiller; the card names no fulfillmentOwner and lists PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET with delivery 'A spreadsheet Brain produces', and Brain attached PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET (PRESENT) to the deliver step, so the hour is Brain's and owner time is 0. I now carry the 1 h/deal explicitly as fulfiller hours and downgrade ownerHours from EVIDENCED to ESTIMATE with the worst case stated.

answers.finding: all 8 deliveries are scheduled on day 6; if the card's 1 human hour is per deal that is ~8 owner hours in week 1, over the 3 h/week ceiling
answers.resolution: Accepted. Deliveries are split into three weekly batches (3 on day 6, 3 on day 12, 2 on day 17) with collections on days 7, 13 and 18, so even in the worst case each week uses at most 3 hours and all $2,800 settles inside 21 days.

reviews.reasons: Stance and cash arithmetic are otherwise sound (8 x $350 = $2,800 >= $2,500, settles day 7 of 21, $40 cost from receipts), but the goal has a 3 hours/week owner-time ceiling and the plan treats owner time as known zero when the card records humanHours 1 and Brain's own run assigns delivery to a PERSON. Owner hours must be carried from the card and the schedule shown to fit 3 h/week before the owner acts.
findings: ownerHours quantity is marked EVIDENCED = 0 citing s_delivery, but the card records humanHours: 1 and Brain's run lists the Deliver step as owner PERSON; the owner-hour figure is contradicted, not evidenced

all 8 deliveries are scheduled on day 6; if the card's 1 human hour is per deal that is ~8 owner hours in week 1, over the 3 h/week ceiling; budget owner hours per step and spread deliveries (e.g. <=3 per week) so every week fits

reviews.reasons: Both findings answered. Owner time is now an ESTIMATE of 0 because the card names no fulfillmentOwner and the delivery is a spreadsheet Brain produces with PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET PRESENT. The worst case, where the 1 h/deal falls to the owner, is scheduled as 3/3/2 deliveries on days 6, 12 and 17, which is 3, 3 and 2 hours in weeks 1-3, all within 3 h/week. Recomputed the cash: 3x$350 on day 7, 3x$350 on day 13 and 2x$350 on day 18 total $2,800, which is at least $2,500 and settles by day 18 of 21. The $40 cost is paid from receipts, no capital is needed, and the ledger matches the steps. Every chain link is evidenced on the card.
